title: One explicitly requested Board-role classification
description: POST /v1/work/v2/items/{id}/persona-suggestion. One tool-less model turn chooses a persona from the machine's closed catalog or says the item is ambiguous. Opening or rendering a Board item never calls it.

expected_version.description: The item version whose title and description the person chose to send for classification.

persona_id.description: An exact id from GET /v1/personas for recommend; empty for ambiguous.

provider.description: The AI provider whose explicit Board-content consent covered this turn.
